codeReview.summary: Clean split of renderer.rs (2,512 lines) into renderer/mod.rs + 9 submodules. All submodules well under 500 lines (largest: readback.rs at 259 lines). mod.rs retains VulkanRenderer struct, UiFrameResources, PendingReadback, OutputRenderTarget, FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT, MAX_OBJECTS_PER_FRAME, and all core lifecycle methods (init, destroy, context, current_frame, wait_for_device, recreate_swapchain, render). Three struct fields correctly widened to pub(super) for submodule access (last_presented_image_index, default_material_handle, pending_readback). All 18 module files exist matching 18 module declarations. lib.rs exports VulkanRenderer, DrawList, UIDrawList, UiDrawCommand correctly. cargo check -p katla_gfx, cargo check -p katla_app, and cargo clippy -p katla_gfx all pass clean.

issues.description: Stale doc comment 'Transpose a 4x4 matrix from row-major to column-major format.' on PendingReadback struct. This is a leftover from the original renderer.rs where a transpose function likely existed before removal. The actual doc 'Pending readback operation for async frame checking' is on the next line but separated by a blank doc line.

sharedStateObservations.observation: When splitting files, the worker uses `pub(super)` visibility for struct fields that submodules need access to (e.g., last_presented_image_index, default_material_handle, pending_readback). This pattern is consistent across all split features and should be documented in the skill.
